transition_types.step_down: Adjacent cells descend to a lower level.
transition_types.step_up: Adjacent cells ascend to a higher level.
transition_types.steep_transition: Large height delta that needs an explicit connector.
transition_types.connector_edge: Transition involving an explicit ramp or stairs connector.

connector_types.slope: Natural or earthwork connector for a one-level transition.
connector_types.ramp: Explicit ramp connector for a one-level transition.
connector_types.stairs: Explicit stairs connector for a one-level transition.
connector_types.bridge: Bridge or platform connector for elevated walkable traversal.

notes: Allowed transitions are directly consumable by movement/pathfinding code.
Blocked transitions mark cliffs, drops, or missing connectors for game-specific handling.
